subject: ACME trial: procurement & billing readiness
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME trial: procurement & billing readiness

Hi Alex -

Thanks again for a great call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we’re all aligned:

- Success criteria you mentioned: reach ~100k token/day sustained across the evaluation week and confirmation that the endpoint integrates with your ingestion pipeline (batch + streaming).
- Trial timeline: POC launched this week; target integration complete by 2026-04-01.
- Procurement path: you said procurement prefers PO + standard SOW/order form (no marketplace purchase).
- Billing start: you requested billing to start once the trial hits the agreed usage threshold (we should confirm the exact measurement window).

Can you confirm the following so our finance/legal teams can prep the right paperwork?
1) Procurement contact for formal PO + expected turnaround (name + email + typical PO lead time).
2) Any specific fields your AP team needs on the invoice (PO number placement, remit-to address, contact).
3) Whether you want Redwood to send an order form for signature or route this via DocuSign/your CLM.

I’m attaching a draft order form and a one-page SOW template for reference (attachment stubs below). Once you confirm procurement cadence we’ll surface an estimated start date for billing and finalize the success/usage gating language.

Proposed next actions:
- Alex: confirm procurement contact + PO timing by EOD Thu 3/19
- Aditya/Jordan: prep draft order form + highlight any MSA clauses we expect to adjust
- Marissa: coordinate with Finance for invoice fields and billing start language

Thanks - looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_Draft_Order_Form_v1.pdf (pdf), MSA_Redwood_Acme_draft.docx (docx)

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME trial: procurement & billing readiness

Hi Marissa -

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the key points from our side:

- Procurement path: we will do a PO + signed order form. We generally avoid marketplace purchases for new platform vendors.
- Procurement contact: Emily Park (emily.park@acme.com), she is our Procurement Lead and handles new vendor PO setup. Typical turnaround is 7-10 business days once the final order form is submitted and legal signs off.
- Invoice fields: Please include the PO number on the invoice header and remit to: ACME Corp, AP Dept, 100 Market St, San Francisco, CA 94105. Our AP team requires net 30 terms by default.
- Trial-to-paid gating: We’re comfortable with billing to begin once we’ve seen 3 consecutive days at or above 100k tokens/day AND integration smoke tests pass. If that sounds reasonable we can aim to move to a paid order by mid-April assuming integration stays on track.

On the DocuSign vs order form: we prefer DocuSign for speed. If you can send the order form via DocuSign and cc Emily + procurement@acme.com, Emily will route internally.

One more ask - can Redwood confirm whether you support invoice-to-PO matching on your side (i.e., include PO number in the invoice metadata) and whether you can accept standard ACME indemnity language or if you need a redline?

Thanks - I’ll loop Emily in on the thread.

- Alex
Alex Johnson
Head of ML Platform, ACME Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com | +1 415 555 9876

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-18T13:22:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: ACME trial: procurement & billing readiness

Alex / Marissa -

Looping in a quick note from Legal/Finance perspective.

- We can include PO number in invoice metadata and place it in the invoice header. Net 30 is standard and acceptable.
- Redwood is happy to send the order form via DocuSign. I’m attaching a draft Order Form and a draft MSA with typical Redwood terms - these are initial drafts and we’re open to reasonable redlines (attachment stubs below).
- Regarding indemnity/terms: we typically accept customer-specified indemnity additions on a case-by-case basis; if ACME has specific clauses, please send them and we’ll flag any items that need escalation.

Marissa - I’ve attached the draft order form + draft MSA. Jordan, can you prepare a short bullet list of any technical acceptance criteria we should include in the SOW (smoke tests, token measurement window, integration checkpoints)?

Aditya Rao
VP, Commercial Operations | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

Attachments (stubs): Redwood_Draft_Order_Form_v1.pdf (pdf), MSA_Redwood_Acme_draft.docx (docx)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Emily Park <emily.park@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@acme.com>
Date: 2026-03-19T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME trial: procurement & billing readiness

Alex / Emily -

Thanks - this all sounds good and actionable. Confirming next steps and proposed gating language for the trial -> paid transition:

1) DocuSign order form: Redwood will send the order form via DocuSign today (I’ll include Emily + procurement@acme.com). Expect the draft with order value, PO fields, and net 30 terms.
2) Success criteria / billing start: Billing will begin when the trial meets both of the following: (a) three consecutive days at or above 100k tokens/day measured on our ingestion endpoint, and (b) successful completion of the integration smoke tests (Jordan will draft the acceptance checklist).
3) Measurement window: we will use UTC daily aggregates for token usage; measurement will be taken at 00:00 UTC and evaluated for the previous 24-hour window.
4) Target move-to-paid date: provisional target is week of 2026-04-12 assuming integration completes on schedule. If usage threshold is hit earlier, we’ll coordinate invoice issuance and start date accordingly.

Emily - could you please confirm expected PO lead time once you receive the DocuSign order form so we can sync timing?

Thanks everyone - looping Jordan for the acceptance checklist.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
